notes.title: 70% Off Daily Deal + Bug Fix Patch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143415/d9eac347aaa6be55bb3d0138517078b8778b3dcd.png[/img]

Happy Cursed to Golf 2nd Anniversary! To celebrate, Cursed to Golf is 70% off, its biggest discount yet!

We've just uploaded a new patch that fixes a bunch of bugs that have been discovered in the game since the last update. These bug fixes primarily target game lock ups and stability, but also some fixes for strange edge cases with various combinations of pins and cards.

Examples include: 
- Fixing loss of input in various scenarios
- Fixed extra long timer on +5 timer pin
- Fixed various issues with Ice Ball
- Fixed issues with bosses, particularly the desert boss
- Fixed some issues with save data

There have been some other reported issues that have been pretty scary -- issues with saving, locking up, losing progress, etc. -- that unfortunately we haven't been able to exactly reproduce and fix, but we are hoping this update makes the game more stable all around so hopefully there will be far fewer opportunities for those bad issues to show up. 

If you do have any issues, please post in the Golf bugs channel in our Discord community ([url=https://discord.gg/chuhailabs]https://discord.gg/chuhailabs[/url]) and we can help you out!

Thank you so much for supporting Cursed to Golf, and we hope you have fun playing :D

notes.title: The GOLF PIN Update! OUT NOW!
notes.content:
It’s the moment you’ve been waiting for, [b]GOLF PINS[/b] are here!

The Cursed to Golf team here at Chuhai Labs is very excited to finally share our latest update with you! The all new GOLF PINS update is available on Steam RIGHT NOW! Go forth and finally ASCEND TO GOLF HEAVEN!

⛳ [i][b]Golf Purgatory just got a big shake up! Say hello to the all-new GOLF PINS! [/b][/i]

Now at the start of each Round you’ll be able to choose from one of three random Golf Pins to take with you on your quest to ascend to Golf Heaven. These magical new objects (some say are a gift from Golf God himself!?) can have a significant impact on how you approach every Hole! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143415/06202b18abcb133cbf1328fa03052e0fb1a450e2.gif[/img]

Bolster your chances of survival in the depths of Golf Purgatory by choosing the Pins to suit your style!
[list]
[*] [i]Want more shots?[/i] Purchase a [b]Destroy All Shot Idols[/b] Pin!
[*] [i]Want a boost from the Tee Off?[/i] Purchase a Tee-Off power Pin such as [b]Tee-Off Rocketball[/b].
[*] [i]Want another chance after failing a Hole?[/i] Purchase a [b]Last Chance[/b] Pin to rewind and act like nothing happened!
[/list]
With over [b]50+ variations[/b] and powers, you’ll find the Golf Pin to match your playstyle and help fix any weaknesses in your game.

💀 [i][b]A Golf-Like too Hellish? Not any more![/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143415/7d31fe021af6bbecf0829b61750b8105966cc10b.gif[/img]

Then these new Golf Pins will help! Choose from tons of combinations to solidify your path to Ascension! Whether you're a seasoned golfer or a newcomer to the course, this update offers a customizable experience that ensures a fun and more approachable game. It’s never been easier to reach the heights of Golf Heaven! You can do it!

🏌️ [i][b]Find your Combo! [/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143415/d34a784a5d1082984bb667cee9bfea91efb8a422.gif[/img]

Equip up to three pins at a time and play to your strengths! You can select Golf Pins that complement how YOU play. Fancy starting every hole with a [b]Tee-Off U-Turn[/b]? GO FOR IT! Or want to challenge yourself and start every hole with a new hand of Ace Cards? [b]New Ace Card Deck[/b] is for you! Choose your three pins wisely and master the course in your own way! That pesky Greenskeeper won’t stand a chance!

🛒 [i][b]Splurge or Shop wisely?[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143415/b4e20064b8b98ad7032b78fbd570224ea18a5d14.gif[/img]

If you want more Golf Pin options (there’s A LOT!) more are now available at your local Eterni-Tee! The ghostly Caddies are waiting for you to check out the new PINS section! Don’t like their options? You can always pay to reroll and reveal three new choices! Try to combo some Pin powers together!

⛳ 💀 ⛳  💀 ⛳

This update is all about enhancing your Golf-Like experience, bringing more fun and strategy to Cursed to Golf than ever before! So Tee up, select your favorite Golf Pins and show that stupid Greenskeeper who's boss! Fore-tunately, it's time to golf like you've never golfed before. Swing into action with The Golf Pins Update now!

notes.title: HAPPY CURSIVERSARY! New Update coming soon!
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Cursiversary![/h1]

The Cursed to Golf team here at Chuhai Labs is celebrating the game’s ONE YEAR ANNIVERSARY! 

[previewyoutube=Yqab24ELGrU;full][/previewyoutube]
We want to say a huge thank you to all of you who have supported us over this year and huge congrats to all who have ASCENDED! In celebration of the anniversary we have a bunch of exciting announcements for you! 

And to those of you who haven’t quite reached Golf Heaven yet, we have a new update coming that’s going to help you finally smash your Golf Ball all the way to the highest of Heavens!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143415/4d2407e5a340ae224d61183867a0168c47713106.png[/img]

[h2]The GOLF PIN Update![/h2]

The team has been hard at work over the last few months to bring you the new [b]Golf Pin[/b] update! This new update balances the Difficulty feedback we received, with a fun new way to customize your playstyle in each Round. With it, this new update also has a whole host of Quality of Life features.

[b]Golf Pins[/b] are a new mechanical addition to Cursed to Golf. You will be able to choose one from three random Pins at the start of each Round and then purchase them in a new section at each Eterni-Tee! Each one can have a large effect on the way you approach each Hole or even each Shot!  

You will be able to equip up to a [i]maximum of three Pins[/i] during each run. Play to your own strengths and choose Pins that compliment your playstyle! 

[list]
[*] Want to start every tee shot in a Hole with a Rocket-ball? [i]NOW YOU CAN![/i]
[*] Explode all Shot Idols when entering a Hole? [i]THERE’S A PIN FOR THAT![/i]
[*] Control the Angle Meter and make perfect shots each time? [i]WHY NOT![/i]
[/list]
Choose wisely and master the Course your own way! Try and combo Pin effects together to really maximize your Round… That cheeky Greenskeeper won’t be able to stop you from reaching Golf Heaven now!

Head into the new “Pins” section in the Eterni-Tee shops and check out which Pins might be available. If you don’t like what you see, you can always Reroll to see three new Pins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143415/efaa9353c1a80074032d3198a8487c65ad74c59b.gif[/img]

Magnets HOW DO THEY WORK?! Missing your final shot at the Hole? Why not just stick a Magnet on it, then you will never miss!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143415/4a62477eb57ccc126fad453dd9f7e0c891faa6c6.gif[/img]

WOMBO-COMBO-GOLFO! Equip up to three Pins at one time. Try to see how you can combo each Pins power to maximize the effects! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143415/7271e95f5c9f93ab8362e58830724f47369601ce.gif[/img]

We are hard at work finishing the update and while we don’t have a release date yet… It is coming SOON. So, get ready to don your best Pins and we hope to see you all reaching Golf Heaven!

[h2]Cursed to Golf OST on Vinyl![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143415/dc987e74a8a85d6c78bc011686621a74cb688b24.png[/img]

[i]BANGIN’ TUNES AND CURSED BLEEPS![/i]

We’ve partnered with our friends at [b]Lost in Cult[/b] and [b]Black Screen Records[/b] to bring you the incredible soundtrack of Cursed to Golf on high quality 180g vinyl! 

This 2xLP set features the energetic chiptunes of the game by composer [i]Mark Sparling[/i], so you can relive your finest drives and memorable caddie moments! The adorable vinyl art is provided by the talented artist, [i]CrisppyBoat[/i] and will include special extras like coasters, stickers, sheet music, and even a postcard from Golf Purgatory! 

Pre-Order yours [url=https://blackscreenrecords.com/products/cursed-to-golf?variant=44665743933706]here[/url]!

Also, if you want to hear what it’s shaping up to sound like here’s a post from game director [i]Liam Edwards[/i] showcasing one of the [url=https://twitter.com/LiamBME/status/1693566079808000095?s=20]test pressings[/url]! 

[h2]Cursed Golfer Plushie Available![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143415/a64037200820bdbda0547293cd2a110fc29c286c.png[/img]

[i]COULD A CURSED GOLFER WITH A TERRIBLE FATE LOOK ANY CUTER?[/i]

We’ve also partnered with plush developers [b]Makeship[/b] to launch our very own [b]Cursed Golfer[/b] campaign! 

But, to bring this incredible, adorable, cute, soft, talented, Cursed LAD to life we need your help with our current campaign! To get our adorable Cursed Golfer in plush form! Act fast! 

The campaign is very limited and only runs through [i][b]September 7, 2023[/b][/i] so get yours today and help us bring this adorable version of our wonderful, Cursed Golfer to reality! 

Check out the campaign and pre-order yours [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/the-cursed-golfer-plush]here[/url]!

[h2]A BIG THANK YOU![/h2]

Thank you to every single one of you Cursed Golfers who has played the game so far! We can't believe even a year later, there's still so many of you checking our experience out and ASCENDING the Golf Heavens! We hope we our latest update even more of you will check out the game and make it to those lofty Heavens! 

Thank you from everyone at Chuhai Labs!

notes.title: The PURGATORY REMIX update is here! (20% OFF CELEBRATION)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143415/25ff8eb1622aec97d8760305daeff7ae1167d1c6.png[/img]
It's been a while Cursed Friends!

The [b]Cursed to Golf[/b] team here at Chuhai Labs has been hard at work since we last spoke! We have been collating feedback, tackling through the forums and listening to all of your comments. A big thank you to all the players who have experienced [i]Golf Purgatory[/i] so far and a special thanks to all players who have taken the time to review, comment, give feedback and help us to make the best darn [b]GOLFLIKE[/b] we possibly can! Hold on to your hats as this is a big one. ːsteamhappyː

And of course with that, we have been hard at work on our first "big" update to Cursed to Golf since launch. Presenting to you the [b]PURGATORY REMIX[/b] update! 

A free update for all players that introduces two additional game modes, Practice Round and Remix Round as well as a host of quality of life updates. Allow me to explain each new mode in a little more detail!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143415/cc4e597918a308d559a471a65dbb4453d356f59a.png[/img]
[b][h3][u]Practice Round:[/u][/h3][/b]
[b]Practice Round[/b] is a new mode we've created to help players with the perils of Golf Purgatory!  

In this new mode, you will be able to start a blank 18-hole run through the [b]Purgatory[/b], [b]Oasis[/b] and [b]Caverns[/b] biomes while setting your own [i]custom rules[/i]! Through [b]Practice Round[/b] you will be able to familiarize yourself with the various dungeon-like holes of [b]Cursed to Golf[/b] and practice making your way through the various hazards in hopes of being able to take on [b]Classic[/b] mode and finally Ascend!
[list]
[*]Set your starting PAR Count.
[*]Enable "Hole Restart" option.
[*]Enable "Cursed Holes" option.
[*]Set your starting Ace Card deck.
[*]Set your "Shot Idol" options.
[*]Set your starting biome area.
[*]Enable "Cursed" rewards each hole.
[/list]
If you're struggling to make it to latter biomes, use [b]Practice Round[/b]! 

[i](Note: There is no story progress or achievement unlocking in Practice Round)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143415/cb671fc289c53925f42c1f8e9a0f274afc3c1d72.png[/img]
[b][h3][u]Remix Round:[/u][/h3][/b]
[b]Remix Round[/b] is a brand-new daunting game mode for those experienced [i]Cursed Golfers[/i] who have already made the [b]Ascension[/b] (or close to)!

Tackle 9-remixed-purgatory-holes, devilishly designed to be the meanest, toughest and most difficult holes yet! Get yourself on a new leaderboard and show off. 
[list]
[*]NO SHOT IDOLS.
[*]NO BOONS.
[*]NO ETERNI-TEE SHOPS.
[*]Survive only on end of hole rewards!
[/list]
If you've finished the 18-holes of Golf Purgatory and Ascended, but left wanting more this is the mode for you. We look forward to seeing you all scream... [i]bwahahaha[/i].

[b][h3][u]Quality of Life - Updates:[/u][/h3][/b]
Alongside the new game modes, we have also added a "hole" host of new quality of life options in the settings menu based on some of the common feedback! We will continue to add additional features and quality of life settings as we move forward. If there's still options you'd like to have included, please leave a comment in the discussions thread! 
[list]
[*]Tutorial Skip option.
[*]Replay tutorial option.
[*]Skip cutscenes option.
[*]Hold to Spin option.
[*]Skip Hole Opening cinematic option.
[*]Auto Fast-Forward - Shot animation. [i](Note: Can be cancelled with pressing FF button)[/i]
[*]Auto Fast-Forward - Transition animation. [i](Note: Can be cancelled with pressing FF button)[/i]
[*]Fast-Forward speed option.
[*]New Driving Range areas added to Oasis and Caverns Eterni-Tee Hubs.
[/list]

We also have been working hard on fixing additional issues, continuing to work on the stability of the overall experience and squashing pesky bugs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143415/d0b09ccc6a763afe04f5f03f38d03244abcf4951.png[/img]
[b][h3][u]SCREAM FESTIVAL 2022 - 20% OFF[/u][/h3][/b]
Finally, as part of the [b]Steam Scream Festival[/b] (it's spooky season!) Cursed to Golf will be a [b]WHOPPING 20% OFF![/b]

If you've enjoyed [b]Cursed to Golf[/b], we'd love if you could tell your friends! Now is a great time to jump in to the world's only GOLFLIKE! 

This deal will run from the following dates [b]October 25th 2022 (10AM PST) - November 1st 2022 (10AM PST)[/b].

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143415/d6c8453224e39b2a549ebe1d93494a5bb7cc9071.jpg[/img]

Greetings cursed Golfers,

It's been a week since [b]Cursed to Golf[/b] opened its gates to Golf Purgatory and the first thing we want to do is to thank you all. So: [u][b]THANK YOU![/b][/u] ❤️ It's so great to see you all playing our little Golflike. And thanks a ton for providing a massive bunch of feedback since the release. And of course we want you to have as much fun as possible with [b]Cursed to Golf[/b]! That's why the update 1.0.3 is available from now on, featuring a bunch of fixes and changes including zoom toggle, mystery pack card changes and upped cash.

But there is way more - this is the complete change log including all fixes and changes:

[u][b]Design Changes:[/b][/u]

[u]Zoom Toggle[/u]
[list][*] New feature - The ability to zoom out has been added.
[*] Players can toggle between the default camera and a new zoomed out frame.
[*] Birdie Eye camera options unchanged.[/list] [u]Cash Rewards[/u]
[list][*] Upped; players will now receive more cash per hole completion.[/list][u]Mystery Booster Packs[/u]

[list][*] Ace Card reward rate upped.
[*] “Practice Shot” added to the card reward pool.[/list][u]Power Meter[/u]
[list][*] Animation speed slowed across all clubs.[/list][u]Angle Meter[/u]
[list][*] Animation speed slowed across all clubs.[/list][u]Curse Trigger UI[/u]
[list][*] Opacity changed; when players change clubs or start a shot the Curse Trigger UI in the top-right corner of the screen will lower in opacity.[/list] 

[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]
[list][*] Fixed issue where controller input is unrecognized upon the main menu.
[*] Fixed issue where Explorer Boss Cutscene “Short” would play incorrectly.
[*] Fixed issue where Hole 16/17 Ace Card chest rewards were incorrect.
[*] Adjust position and appearance of the auto-saving icon.
[*] Fixed issue where Ace Cards could be interacted with while the “Curse Survived” banner was playing in Cursed holes, causing input issues.
[*] Ace Card Chest icons flip immediately after opening them on the World Map.
[*] Fixed issue with Course Map not scrolling enough to show all holes.
[*] Disabled the ability to fast-forward through the final textbox of cutscenes.
[*] Disabled the ability to fast-forward through the Boss “Boon Unlocked” textbox.
[*] Increased scroll speed of Course Map when using mouse wheel input.
[*] Fixed issue where Eterni-tee hub objects couldn't immediately be interacted.
[*] Fixed issue with fast-forwarding Boss golf shots, causing issues.
[*] Golf Ball is now destroyed when colliding with the camera collision boundary.
[*] Fixed art issue with lava pits in Hole 18.
[*] Fixed missing localization text for the Forgotten “Short” intro cutscene.
[*] Fixed issue where cutscenes wouldn't pause on the final dialog before a playable section of a cutscene.
[*] Ace Card controls UI tip box issues addressed.
[*] Fixed issue where the equivalent of "NEW ROUND" in Italian and Brazilian Portuguese localization was mixed.
[*] Fixed issue where the Explorer’s “Gimme” wouldn't trigger when going into a Mimic.
[*] Force game app into the nearest supported resolution when on a display with an unsupported aspect ratio or resolution.
[*] Fixed issue where Golf Ball would fall out of Pipe Rail entrances when fast-forwarding.
[*] Fixed issue with camera when using a radial controlled Ace Card at the starting point of a hole.
[*] Fixed issue where the Scotsman would sometimes appear to jump forward in position before taking a shot.
[*] Fixed issue where Front 9 and Back 9 trophies would sometimes not trigger.
[*] Fixed issue where the wrong rewards would be given in Ace Card chests.
[*] Master Audio set to 75% by default.[/list]
Thank you so much for the ongoing interest and feedback for [b]Cursed to Golf[/b]. You folks are purely awesome, each and everyone of you! ❤️

We’ll see you on the leaderboard!
Liam & the Chuhai Labs Team

notes.title: What the heck is a "GOLFLIKE"? Proudly introducing you to Cursed to Golf!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143415/0aacfa0537723e7ee3526c31b952c8a45c6ceeb5.jpg[/img]

Hey there Golfers,

It's Liam again. We are going to open the courses of [b]Cursed to Golf[/b] for you in around 2 days. So, you still have some time to polish your golf clubs and improve your skills. And believe me, you will definitely need skills to master the world's first [u][b]GOLFLIKE[/b][/u]!

If you're asking yourself "What the hell is a Golflike?" we'd like to take this opportunity to let you know what [b]Cursed to Golf[/b] is and what you can expect from our game. Let's go, folks!

[b]Cursed to Golf[/b] is a golf game for those that want a bit of randomized hellish masochism thrown in for good measure. We've always described it as a "Golflike" in reference to one of the genres we have been inspired by: Roguelikes. You'll start every run with some Ace Cards and a randomly ordered 18 hole course. No, we did not procedurally generate the holes. We figured out pretty quickly that randomly generating a fair and completable golf course wouldn't quite make the CUT.

[b]So, Cursed to Golf in a nutshell:[/b]

[list][*] Unique & challenging Arcade-style Golf game
[*] Roguelike-inspired Game Loop
[*] 4 biomes and bosses in Golf Purgatory
[*] 70+ hand-designed holes
[*] 20+ Ace Cards to help you ascend
[*] 3 golf clubs: driver, iron and wedge
[*] Online leaderboards to challenge the world!
[*] A wide selection of unlockable costumes
[*] Estimated playtime of 7-8 hours (to beat 18 holes for the first time)[/list]
And once you beat the campaign of [b]Cursed to Golf[/b] for the first time, you have only seen 18 holes out of overall 70+ holes. You can continue playing afterwards without worrying, because there is a lot more to see! Check it out in action here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zPZoEtye8BA
May the fores be with you, hit ‘em long and straight and go low!
Liam & the Chuhai Labs Team

notes.title: Steam Next Fest - DEMO UPDATE!
notes.content:
Hello all you [i][b]Cursed Golfers[/b][/i]! 

Thank you for joining us once again for another rad Steam event! This time to celebrate this summer's [b]Steam Next Festival [/b] and [b]Cursed to Golf[/b]'s first time in the festival, we have a huge new update to the demo for you all to enjoy ːsteamthumbsupː

We have been hard at work putting the final touches to the game before we launch (TBA) later this summer. As part of that hard work, we wanted to share our revamped Golfin' Hell in a small slice via a new updated, [b]Scotsman Demo[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143415/defd12dea375fdc354131994153e3d8a9c7476b2.jpg[/img]

New visuals across the golfing landscape including; new course map, visual updates to animations, flair for booster pack openings and a whole bunch more touches that make this the best darn pixel-art golf purgatory experience you can get. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143415/56d54954740341d18f277cb1bd23b440bf422e8e.jpg[/img]

Thanks to everyone during the demo's first outing as well for all of your incredible comments, positive response and feedback. We have been working hard on making sure [b]Cursed to Golf[/b] is as tight, fun and enjoyable as we know you all want it to be. This updated demo includes a whole host of bug fixes to make your experience even more enjoyable! However, please be reminded that this still is a work-in-progress, so any new bugs you encounter or see (1. CONGRATS), please leave us a comment in the discussions thread or hit us up on [url=https://twitter.com/ChuhaiLabs?s=20&t=mGeoBYl2XzeeednEiC0tfQ]Twitter[/url]. 

For all you score chasers as well, we have a leaderboard for you to SMASH while taking down that pesky Scotsman! So, get your practice in and record some high-scores, show off to your friends! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41143415/f386969bb94f93c155ec298ab4f2cf591273dd45.jpg[/img]

Thank you everyone for checking out Cursed to Golf this week, we here at Chuhai Labs hope you have a great time playing our demo! Feel free to leave feedback and comments in the discussions thread. 

Thanks

Liam & the Golf Team.

notes.title: DEMO EXTENSION! (and updates...)
notes.content:
[i]Greetings fellow Cursed Ones! [/i]

Game Director, Liam Edwards here :) 

Firstly, I want to thank everyone who has downloaded and played the [b]Cursed to Golf[/b] demo so far! The response has been quite overwhelming with lots of you sharing your shots, playthroughs and game content via YouTube, Twitter and Twitch. It's been wonderful for myself and the team to see! We are so glad that many of you have been having fun with the demo and our game even in this small slice.

[h3]GOLF FACT: 
Over 60 budding Cursed Golfers have taken down the Scotsman already![/h3]

A big thank you to those of you who have engaged with us in the discussion threads here on Steam and helped track down issues, suggest updates for the future and given us great feedback! It's all incredibly appreciated. 

As part of the response we wanted to give back a little more - we have been asked by many to extend the demo period for longer, So... we've done just that! 

You now have until: 
[h1]April 1st [/h1] ːsteamthumbsupː

(No joke... hehe). 

So, please continue to enjoy this small slice of our Golfing Purgatory area and bring that cheeky [b]Scotsman[/b] down to his knees! 

We will continue to monitor the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1726120/discussions/]discussions thread[/url] and engage with the community via [url=https://twitter.com/CursedtoGolf]Twitter[/url] so please share your scores, your shots and even your gameplay, we love to see how you are all getting along! 

As part of the demo extension, we have also updated the game with a few fixes and QOL improvements that should make your experience in Golfing Purgatory even more enjoyable. Please find a list of fixes included in the update.

[h3][u][b]3/29th Hotfix Update:[/b][/u][/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Controls[/b] - "W" on Keyboard to cancel docked Ace Cards; Switched to "C"
[*] [b]Ace Card Deck [/b]- Controller Hint Tab in Ace Cards now set to be visible by default
[*] [b]Ace Card: Mulligan[/b] - Will now also revert "-1 Penalties" as well as the taken shot 
[*] [b]Birdie Eye[/b] - Timer now set to refresh to "01:00" per turn, not per hole
[*] [b]Cursed Holes[/b] - "Shots" text removed in the build up to a Curse becoming active
[*] [b]Spin Tutorial[/b] - Tutorial text adjusted to be more understandable and clear 
[/list]

Please if you have enjoyed the Cursed to Golf Demo, share it with your friends and family also please consider giving us a wishlist here on Steam! 

Thank you everyone! 

Liam & the Chuhai Labs Team.
